summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full watchlist path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `watchlistRouter` middleware → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite.  **The backend is correctly scoped today.** Every watchlist query filters on `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, and `userId` comes only from a server-verified session (`arca_session` cookie → `getSession(token)` → DB join on non-expired session). The client can't spoof `X-User-Id`; the router middleware overwrites it. `login()` always resolves to the same stable `user.id` for
